title: Chipotle stock falls on potential link to salmonella outbreak in Minnesota
summary: Chipotle's stock has experienced a decline due to concerns over a potential salmonella outbreak linked to its food supply in Minnesota. In response, the company has proactively removed the affected ingredients from its restaurants and has sourced replacement peppers from different growers. This incident highlights the ongoing challenges that food companies face in maintaining food safety and consumer trust.
